text:
ana: Hey team, opening a quick thread for the audit-export docs PR I'm preparing. Main goals: add a migration note for the SDK rename, update example export payloads to avoid PII, and fix a broken anchor in the Console export docs. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1499
ryan: Thanks. Can you paste the SDK snippet you're planning to include? I want to sanity-check the method name and placeholders.
nana: (typo) ana: sure — current snippet is JS and intentionally minimal:```js
// before: client.audit.exportLogs({ start, end })
// after:
const exportJob = await client.audit.startExport({
  filter: {start: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', end: '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z', types: ['access']},
  destination: {type: 's3', bucket: '<BUCKET_NAME>'}
});
console.log(exportJob.id);
```
joel: That looks fine, but change bucket to `<YOUR_BUCKET>` and ensure we don't show example AWS creds anywhere. Also note RBAC: only org owners can call startExport.
nana: noted again ;). I'll update placeholders. For the REST example I have a curl:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"filter":{"start":"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2024-01-31T23:59:59Z"},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<YOUR_BUCKET>"}}'
```
ryan: Good. Compliance nit: add a sentence that example payloads mask PII and that by default audit logs include internal identifiers, not raw emails. Maybe add the compliance-bot note.
compliance-bot: Reminder: policy requires that public docs do not include real emails, SSNs, IP addresses in examples. Use <REDACTED> or internal ids.
nana: Will add a short warning above code blocks: "Examples use masked or internal identifiers; do not assume these show PII."
joel: Also we should add a tiny migration subsection: "If you used client.audit.exportLogs(), switch to client.audit.startExport() and update your payload to include a destination object (S3/GCS)." Keep it one sentence.
ryan: One more: the Console link is currently pointing to /console/audit#exporting but the new build uses /console/audit#exports. Can you change the link and add a short redirect note?
nana: Yep will update to #exports and add a short note: "If you saved an old link, it should redirect, but update bookmarks."
compliance-bot: Automated check: PR 1499 flagged missing timezone note. Recommend: "All sample timestamps are UTC (Z)."
nana: Adding the UTC note. Plan: push an update with renamed placeholders, RBAC sentence, migration one-liner, UTC note, compliance callout, and link fix. I'll ping when done.
joel: Thanks. Quick follow-up after update: can we include a one-line pointer to the retention policy page and say that retention changes are recorded as `policy.update` events? Helps auditors.
nana: Good idea - adding that line with a link to /docs/compliance/retention.
ryan: LGTM once updated.
compliance-bot: PR 1499 pre-check passed for placeholders and anchor fix on next commit.
